value.summary: Management has demonstrated high credibility by consistently delivering on aggressive growth and profitability targets in the quick commerce segment. They maintain a disciplined, first-principles approach to capital allocation, prioritizing long-term return on capital over short-term market share gains through unsustainable discounting.

promises.quote: we don't expect net working capital to be beyond those 18 days that we had shared earlier
promises.promised: Maintain net working capital within 18 days.
promises.actual_delivered: Net working capital was reduced to 14 days as of July 2026 and further guided to 12 days in the Jul 2026 transcript (page 12).
promises.reasoning: The company successfully kept working capital well below the 18-day threshold.

promises.quote: we now expect the losses to come down sequentially from here towards breakeven in the next four to six quarters.
promises.promised: Going-out (District) business to reach breakeven within 4-6 quarters from Jan 2026.
promises.actual_delivered: Reported numbers show Net Profit turned positive in Dec 2025 (Rs 102 cr) and remained positive through Sep 2026 (Rs 125 cr).
promises.reasoning: The consolidated entity reached and maintained profitability ahead of the implied timeline for the specific segment's contribution.

promises.quote: the full benefit should accrue in the next six to nine months, and the benefit will not be more than 1%.
promises.promised: Full 1% margin benefit from the inventory model transition to accrue by Oct 2026.
promises.actual_delivered: The Oct 2026 transcript (page 5) confirms the transition is at a steady state with 90-95% 1P inventory.
promises.reasoning: The transition to the inventory model was completed within the promised timeframe.

promises.quote: We're on track on our guidance for March of 3,000 stores. We remain firmly on track.
promises.actual_delivered: The Oct 2026 transcript (page 12) notes the store count grew 50% YoY, and management accelerated targets to 4,000+ stores for FY28.
promises.reasoning: Management confirmed they are on track and subsequently increased the target due to high confidence.

promises.quote: As we move to 5-6% margin that we are saying we will get to at some point
promises.promised: Achieve 5-6% Adjusted EBITDA margin in quick commerce.
promises.actual_delivered: The Jul 2026 transcript (page 3) upgraded this long-term guidance to 6% based on increased efficiency.
promises.reasoning: Management met the initial range and felt confident enough to raise the target to the upper bound.

guidance.quote: We maintain that guidance as of now.

guidance.target: Food delivery margins to remain flattish over the next 1 to 2 years
guidance.quote: broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish.

guidance.target: 2,000 stores by end of FY27 and 4,000 stores by end of FY28
guidance.quote: Incrementally, you're talking about nearly doubling dark stores over the next 6 to 7 quarters.

guidance.target: Steady state NOV per day per store of INR 11 lakh
guidance.quote: We gave guidance last time that in steady state it could get to about INR 11 lakh per day per store.

bull.point: Quick commerce margins are expanding despite high competitive intensity, with long-term targets raised to 6%.
bull.quote: we now have higher visibility on margins and we think at this point we're likely to end at the higher end of the range

bull.point: Successful expansion into Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities showing robust economics and high payback.
bull.quote: What we have seen so far is that the economics are pretty robust. Paybacks are extremely good in these markets.

bear.point: Competitive intensity in quick commerce is at an all-time high, characterized by aggressive customer subsidies.
bear.quote: First quarter, so far, was the peak of competitive intensity that we have seen till date

bear.point: Capex per store has increased significantly to INR 2.5 crore due to supply chain automation and larger store sizes.
bear.quote: you have given INR 2.5 crore versus INR 1 crore earlier. Is that INR 1 crore comparable?

bear.point: New entrants in the food delivery space are creating unexpected competitive pressure in a mature category.
bear.quote: It doesn't make sense to us at all either and we are equally surprised.
